Protect from light. USP 31 (Iopamidol). A white to off-white, practically odourless, powder. Very soluble in water; practically insoluble in alcohol and in chloroform; sparingly soluble in methyl alcohol. Store at a temperature of 25°, excursions permitted between 15° and 30°. Protect from light. Adverse Effects, Treatment, and Precautions As for the amidotrizoates, p.1475.
